      "claim": "The cumulative effect of mundane adaptations might intensify human isolation or alienation from the earth in its givenness, cutting people off from awareness of their earthbound limitations.",

    },

      "claim": "Modern science interposes humanly made technologies of observation and measurement between us and the world, cutting humans off from reality.",
